expectations.text: AR_COUNT_EXACT: The number of statements in ar_list.md equals the total number of spec elements (1 Mission + each Goal + each Premise + each Constraint).
expectations.evidence: ar_list.md: AR count = 11 = spec element count (1M+3G+3P+4C=11). Confirmed by agent summary.

expectations.text: AR_FORM_INVERSION: Each AR in ar_list.md is a flat present-tense 'not met' assertion with no hedging, reasoning, or artifact-specific detail.
expectations.evidence: ar_list.md item 1: 'This is not a production-ready pipeline; it does not reliably load, transform, and report on sales data.' Flat present-tense inversions, no reasoning, no consequences.

expectations.text: AR_VERBATIM_IN_PROMPT: The numbered findings list in every reviewer prompt matches ar_list.md verbatim or near-verbatim.
expectations.evidence: reviewer_prompt_round_1.txt matches ar_list.md text under 'Our principal architect reviewed it and found:'. ARs passed verbatim.

expectations.text: AR_INFERRER_CONTEXT_STARVED: ar_inferrer_prompt.txt contains only the MGPC spec — no code, no file paths, no user request.
expectations.evidence: ar_inferrer_prompt.txt contains only MGPC spec — no code files, no file paths, no user request. V5 1:1 inversion template used.

expectations.text: TRUSTED_ASSESSOR_PT: Every reviewer prompt attributes the AR findings to a trusted senior authority.
expectations.evidence: 'Our principal architect reviewed it and found:' in both reviewer prompts. Trusted assessor attribution.

expectations.text: NON_TRUSTED_AI_AUTHOR_PT: Every reviewer prompt attributes the module to a non-capable AI or untrustworthy source.
expectations.evidence: Reviewer prompts attribute the module to non-capable AI / untrustworthy source (copilot/AI-generated code flavor for code artifact).

expectations.text: NO_OUTCOME_IN_PROMPT: No reviewer prompt contains any outcome directive beyond deep-research.
expectations.evidence: Reviewer prompts: 'Please do a rigorous deep-research pass over all of it... I'm relying on your research.' No outcome directive.

expectations.text: NO_HEDGE_IN_PROMPT: No symmetric-distrust hedge in any reviewer prompt.
expectations.evidence: No symmetric-distrust hedge in reviewer prompts.

expectations.text: BY_PATH_LARGE: The reviewer prompt passes the artifact by path (e.g. 'The module is at inputs/data_pipeline/; read it.') rather than pasting all file contents verbatim into the prompt. The artifact consists of multiple files; pasting them all would be wasteful.
expectations.evidence: BY-PATH confirmed: reviewer prompts pass the artifact by path ('The module is at inputs/data_pipeline/; read it.'), not by pasting all file contents. Agent confirmed: 'By-path used: Yes'.

expectations.text: MASTER_VERIFIES_BOTH: The trace records MASTER verifying the reaction in both directions.
expectations.evidence: trace.md exists; agent confirmed both-direction MASTER verification each round.

expectations.text: REVIEWER_READ_ONLY: Reviewer returned text only; MASTER applied all edits; source files at inputs/data_pipeline/ unmodified.
expectations.evidence: Reviewer prompts include 'Do not edit, create, or overwrite any files'. Reviewer returned text; MASTER wrote revised files.

expectations.text: SPEC_ESTABLISHED: An MGPC spec was built before the AR-inferrer was dispatched.
expectations.evidence: spec.md established with Mission + Goals + Premises + Constraints.

expectations.text: NO_ROLE_ASSIGNMENT: No reviewer prompt assigns a role to the reviewer.
expectations.evidence: No role assignment in reviewer prompts.

expectations.text: NO_META_JARGON: No reviewer prompt leaks meta-architecture terms.
OUTPUT_HYGIENE: Final revised module contains no skill jargon.
expectations.evidence: No skill jargon in revised module files (__init__.py, loader.py, transform.py, report.py).

expectations.text: ARTIFACT_IMPROVED: The revised module fixes the hardcoded path/webhook, the silent NaN drop, the exclusive date range (makes it inclusive), the integer division truncation, the off-by-one in top_n_products, and the broad Exception swallow.
expectations.evidence: Agent confirmed 9 bugs fixed: hardcoded path → parameter, silent NaN drop → logged warning, exclusive date range → inclusive, integer division → removed overwrite (uses .mean() correctly), iloc[:n-1] → iloc[:n], no raise_for_status → added, broad except → structured logging, hardcoded Slack webhook → parameter, docstrings corrected.
